description_zh: ego（后方乘用车）在同车道直行接近，前车（Waymo AV）因红灯停在路口，ego 未能及时刹停，追尾碰撞前车。

source_snippets: the front of the passenger car which was following behind the Waymo AV made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
As the Waymo AV came to a stop for a red light
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 2 (X for C. Rear End)
evidence.reason: 后车直行追尾前车，前车静止等待红灯，符合 rear-end collision 场景，可映射为 ego（后车）直行遇 ahead_same_lane 的 stopped_ahead NPC。
